description: Presidential Secretariat  - Prorogue the Parliament w.e.f. Midnight of the 02.12.2019 and hereby fix the 03.01.2020 at 10.00 a.m. for the Commencement of the next Session and summon the Parliament
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential proclamation proroguing Parliament and summoning it to meet on a specified future date. This directly relates to parliamentary procedures and the scheduling of legislative sessions, which falls under electoral and parliamentary processes. According to the classification rules, Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) includes "Election announcements and schedules" and parliamentary summoning/commencement of sessions is a core function of electoral and parliamentary administration.
